hero.title: Heart Disease & Cardiomyopathy
hero.subtitle: Supportive clinical management aiming to strengthen heart function and vitality through integrated Ayurvedic protocols.

quickAnswer: Cardiomyopathy is a disease of the heart muscle that makes it harder for your heart to pump blood to the rest of your body. In Ayurveda, our approach focuses on strengthening the myocardium (heart muscle), reducing fluid overload, and clearing the channels of circulation to provide supportive care alongside your primary medical treatment.
whatItMeans: When the heart muscle weakens, patients often experience breathlessness, swelling in the legs, and extreme fatigue. This condition requires careful, ongoing management. Rather than claiming a structural reversal, our goal is to halt progression, reduce the burden on the heart, and significantly improve your quality of life.
ayurvedicContext: In Ayurveda, this is often correlated with 'Hrid Roga', arising from an imbalance of the Vata and Pitta doshas. When Ama (toxins) obstructs the Rasa (plasma) and Rakta (blood) channels, the heart must work harder. Additionally, diminished Ojas (the ultimate essence of health) results in muscular weakness.
howTreatmentIsPlanned: Treatment begins with a thorough pulse diagnosis (Nadi Pariksha) and a review of your modern diagnostics (like an Echocardiogram). The core protocol involves the internal administration of Hridya (heart-strengthening) herbs like Arjuna and Pushkarmool, strict Pathya (dietary regimens restricting sodium and fluid), and gentle therapies to reduce the workload on the heart.

therapies.name: Hrid Basti
therapies.description: Retention of warm medicated oil over the heart region to nourish cardiac muscles and relieve stress.

therapies.name: Abhyanga
therapies.description: Gentle therapeutic massage to improve peripheral circulation and reduce Vata imbalance without overtaxing the heart.

whoShouldSeek: You may consider our Ayurvedic consultation if you are looking to support your heart health naturally, wish to improve your exercise tolerance, and are seeking a holistic approach to cardiovascular wellness. You must continue your prescribed life-saving medications.
patientJourney: Patients often notice a reduction in acute symptoms like swelling and breathlessness within 3-4 weeks of strict adherence to our diet and herbal protocols. Measurable improvements in vitality typically require 6 to 12 months of consistent therapy and lifestyle modification.

faqs.q: Is Ayurvedic treatment safe alongside my current heart medications?
faqs.a: Yes. We strongly advise against abruptly stopping any life-saving allopathic medications. Our Ayurvedic protocols are designed to be taken safely alongside your current prescriptions, with appropriate time gaps.

While complete reversal of structural damage is highly challenging, our treatments focus on halting disease progression, strengthening remaining healthy tissue, and significantly improving cardiac output and quality of life. [VERIFY BEFORE PUBLICATION]
